# Youth + Ignorance

Youth + Ignorance is a creative studio focused on direction, CGI, motion design and animation. The studio is based in Stuttgart, Germany, and is operated by Böttner, Eisler, Seemann & Wagner GbR.

## Official pages

- [Portfolio](https://www.youthandignorance.com/)
- [Birdshot](https://www.youthandignorance.com/projects/birdshot.html)
- [Sentient Shore](https://www.youthandignorance.com/projects/sentient-shore.html)
- [Perfect Hue](https://www.youthandignorance.com/projects/perfect-hue.html)
- [Experiments](https://www.youthandignorance.com/experiments.html)
- [Imprint](https://www.youthandignorance.com/imprint.html)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.youthandignorance.com/privacy-policy.html)

## Services

- Creative direction and concept development
- CGI and 3D animation
- Motion design
- AI-assisted image and video production
- Art direction and design

## Selected work

- Birdshot — animated short film exploring emotional numbness toward crises and violence.
- Sentient Shore — animation and CGI project.
- Perfect Hue — animated short film about attention and the warping of perception and reality.
- Experiments — an evolving collection of motion, CGI, image and video studies.
